method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer, 'until' bars encoded as bars); dates and times in a small module, the rules in one module and the family's questions in a seat module importing it; three regulative rules (the 14-day and 48-hour steps, the s 58C(4) duty to provide records, the 48-hour bars on autopsy and exhumation) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Coroners Act 1995 (Tas), No. 73 of 1995, consolidated version published 2025-12-01 and current at point in time 2026-11-06, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-1995-073.txt (text sha256 fc128fbec883f7933bafab4edb00a0a5417e300043660556b79d35a1a60f5371 per the meta), retrieved from legislation.tas.gov.au on 2026-11-06

seat: the family member of the person who died, above all the senior next of kin (s 3A), and any other person a coroner considers has a sufficient interest in a death, fire or explosion, including the person whose property the coroner or police hold (tco-seat.l4); s 19 and the offences are asked from the same seat

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run tco-dates.l4 ; l4 run tco-rules.l4 ; l4 run tco-seat.l4 ; l4 run tco-cases.l4
checks.result: 204 assertions written, 204 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics were read; satisfied assertions were counted by distinct source range. Expected values worked by hand from the text.
